scope: R2-owned acceptance between its existing candidate ingress and an explicit future read ingress. The production top keeps read_candidate_in inactive; no read producer, registry allocation, R1 read launch, response deposition, source delivery, scoreboard event, physical-memory, timing, throughput, PPA, numeric RTL, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE behavior is activated.

module.name: route_a_core_side_arbiter
module.rule: Both acceptable ingresses are compared only by their existing arrival_ordinal then candidate_id; one exact record is stored in existing R2 candidate state.

required_invariants: Top cannot choose between existing and read logical ingress offers.
No new FIFO, credit, cursor, request-ID, or response state is created.
R2 read rotation remains unchanged and advances only on core-memory request acceptance.
A stalled read ingress record remains stable.
Production top keeps read_candidate_in inactive until a shared registry-allocation composition owner is closed.
explicitly_not_activated: RTL2.3.1 adapter or RTL2.3.2 bridge/merge top instance
read context allocation competing with existing write allocation
typed response delivery and P3/S2/direct payload or sidecar deposit
source deliverability, GQA commit/release, R4, lifecycle, authority, scoreboard events
